rows.text: In the Rajya Sabha on 10 December 1991, under the item headed 'REGARDING "EKTA YATRA" BY B.J.P. PRESIDENT', Shri V. Narayanasamy (Pondicherry) asks the Home Minister 'to immediately stop this Ekta Yatra, by the BJP President, Dr. Murli Manohar Joshi'.
